description: Execute ExtendScript (JSX) inside Photoshop and return the result. Runs as a function body: end with `return <value>`. ES3 only. Key DOM: app.documents, activeDocument, artLayers, layerSets, selection (polygon points), doc.saveAs/exportDocument, charIDToTypeID for ActionDescriptor work. GOTCHAS: the active document can silently change between calls — start scripts with app.activeDocument = app.documents.getByName(...); text sizes/positions need new UnitValue(n,'px') (plain numbers can throw 'Internal error'); no ellipse selection (pass a 72-point polygon); layer edits require the doc frontmost. More: knowledge_search.
name: ps_run_extendscript
title: Run ExtendScript in Photoshop
